Vendor shall not delete, degrade, or withhold access to Customer Data during the transition period, and shall not condition transition assistance on payment of disputed amounts or on a release.","comment":"Replace with full transition assistance and data-return protection."}},{"ruleId":"NONCOMPETE","status":"deviation","paragraphIds":["p0050"],"quote":"During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.","rationale":"Unbounded 24-month non-compete restraining Customer's business and M&A; contradicts §12.3.","confidence":0.95,"replacement":{"paragraphId":"p0050","oldText":"During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.","newText":"","comment":"Delete in full; confidentiality obligations in §16.2 already protect Vendor."}},{"ruleId":"LICENSE","status":"deviation","paragraphIds":["p0052"],"quote":"Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.","rationale":"At-will revocable licence excluding Affiliates/contractors; contradicts §§13.2, 13.3, 24.1 and Affiliate ordering.","confidence":0.93,"replacement":{"paragraphId":"p0052","oldText":"Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.","newText":"13.1 Subject to this Agreement, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a worldwide, non-exclusive, irrevocable (during the applicable subscription term) licence to access and use the Services and Documentation for their internal business purposes, including through contractors, service providers, and Authorized Users acting on their behalf, for whose compliance Customer is responsible. Vendor may suspend or revoke access only as expressly permitted by Section 13.3.","comment":"Broaden licence scope and remove discretionary revocation."}},{"ruleId":"WARRANTY","status":"deviation","paragraphIds":["p0076"],"quote":"For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.","rationale":"15-day warranty with total remedy cut-off operates as a disguised disclaimer cutting off §19.1 and §19.4 remedies.","confidence":0.92,"replacement":{"paragraphId":"p0076","oldText":"For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.","newText":"19.2 Each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and the applicable acceptance criteria for ninety (90) days after acceptance. The warranty period in this Section does not limit Section 19.1, Section 19.4, or any other remedy available to Customer, and does not operate as a limitation period for any claim.","comment":"Extend to 90 days and remove remedy cut-off."}},{"ruleId":"LOL-CAP","status":"deviation","paragraphIds":["p0082","p0084","p0007"],"quote":"Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.","rationale":"One-month fee cap 'without exception' overrides Excluded Claims; cap base further shrunk by §1.5 Fees definition. Excluded Claims also omit §19.3 and §26 breaches.","confidence":0.95,"replacement":{"paragraphId":"p0082","oldText":"Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.","newText":"21.1 Subject to Sections 21.3 and 21.4, each Party's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the greater of (a) USD [—] and (b) the total amounts paid and payable by Customer under the applicable Order Form in the twelve (12) months preceding the first event giving rise to the claim. Liability for Excluded Claims is not subject to this cap.","comment":"12-month cap with Excluded Claims preserved; amend §1.5 so 'Fees' includes implementation and one-time charges."}},{"ruleId":"INDEMN","status":"missing","paragraphIds":["p0080","p0038"],"quote":"20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.","rationale":"No Vendor indemnity at all (no IP, data-breach or compliance indemnity); Customer indemnity is unlimited and uncapped; §9.3 cross-refers to non-existent §20.5.","confidence":0.95,"replacement":{"paragraphId":"p0080","oldText":"20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.","newText":"20. INDEMNIFICATION
20.1 Vendor IP Indemnity. Vendor shall defend Customer, its Affiliates, and their personnel against any third-party claim that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, or trade secret, and shall indemnify against resulting damages, settlements, and reasonable costs.
20.2 Vendor Other Indemnities. Vendor shall defend and indemnify Customer against third-party claims arising from (a) Vendor's breach of Sections 15, 16 or 17 or a Security Incident affecting Customer Data; (b) Vendor's violation of Applicable Law; (c) death, personal injury, or tangible property damage caused by Vendor; and (d) claims by Vendor personnel or subcontractors relating to their engagement.
20.3 Customer Indemnity. Customer shall defend and indemnify Vendor against third-party claims that Customer Data, as provided by Customer, infringes third-party IP or violates Applicable Law, except to the extent arising from Vendor's breach, negligence, or wilful misconduct.
20.4 Procedure. Prompt notice (delay excuses only to the extent of prejudice), indemnitor control of defence with reputable counsel, indemnitee right to participate at its own cost, no settlement imposing liability, admission, or non-monetary obligation on the indemnitee without consent.
20.5 Infringement Remedies. If a claim under 20.1 arises or is reasonably likely, Vendor shall at its expense (a) procure the right to continue use; or (b) modify or replace the item so it is non-infringing with materially equivalent functionality. If neither is achievable within thirty (30) days, either Party may terminate the affected Order Form and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees plus, for perpetual/paid-up items, Fees paid depreciated on a five-year straight-line basis. Exclusions: no obligation to the extent infringement arises solely from Customer Data or Customer's unauthorised modification.","comment":"Reciprocal indemnity structure; also repairs the §9.3 cross-reference."}},{"ruleId":"AUDIT","status":"deviation","paragraphIds":["p0087","p0090"],"quote":"Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period","rationale":"Vendor has full audit rights over Customer while §23 (Customer assurance) is an empty heading; audit right also lacks a self-help remedy limit.","confidence":0.8},{"ruleId":"IP","status":"deviation","paragraphIds":["p0057","p0005"],"quote":"the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer","rationale":"'Improve the Services' is broader than §15.1 limits and could permit product development on Customer material; §1.3 telemetry carve-out lacks de-identification standard and re-identification ban.","confidence":0.75,"replacement":{"paragraphId":"p0057","oldText":"solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer","newText":"solely to provide, secure, and support the Services for Customer, and to improve the Services provided that such improvement does not involve use of Customer Data other than as permitted by Section 15.1","comment":"Narrow the improvement right."}},{"ruleId":"INSURANCE","status":"deviation","paragraphIds":["p0072","p0073"],"quote":"professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000","rationale":"E&O limit low for deal size; cancellation notice only 'to the extent available'; no additional insured, waiver of subrogation, or tail coverage.","confidence":0.8},{"ruleId":"GOVLAW","status":"compliant","paragraphIds":["p0108","p0109"],"quote":"governed by the laws of the State of New York","rationale":"New York law and exclusive New York County venue accepted; only minor confirmation on escalation carve-out noted.","confidence":0.75},{"ruleId":"T4C","status":"compliant","paragraphIds":["p0039"],"quote":"Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty days' prior written notice","rationale":"Customer-favourable convenience termination with refund; concern is only that §2.1 undermines it.","confidence":0.8},{"ruleId":"RENEWAL","status":"compliant","paragraphIds":["p0033"],"quote":"renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal","rationale":"Short 30-day opt-out with reminder obligation; no issue raised in the review.","confidence":0.7},{"ruleId":"ASSIGN","status":"compliant","paragraphIds":["p0092","p0093","p0095"],"quote":"Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor","rationale":"Assignment and change-of-control provisions are customer-favourable; no issue flagged.","confidence":0.75}]}

findings.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
findings.rationale: Take-or-pay $6M commitment with no exit survives all termination rights, rendering them worthless.

replacement.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
replacement.newText: Any minimum volume commitment will be stated in an Order Form. No minimum commitment applies to any period after the effective date of a termination under Sections 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4 or 27.3, and unused commitment will be credited against amounts otherwise payable.
replacement.comment: Delete take-or-pay; tie any commitment to Order Form with termination carve-outs.

findings.quote: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
findings.rationale: Three-year exclusivity with no carve-outs or performance conditions; contradicts §12.3.

replacement.oldText: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
replacement.comment: Delete exclusivity; also renumber the duplicate §2.2.

findings.quote: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
findings.rationale: No exit assistance and immediate deletion of Customer Data, even on Vendor breach; contradicts §§10.1, 10.2, 11.2, 11.3.

replacement.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
replacement.newText: 11.1 On Customer's request at any time during the term and for twelve (12) months following expiry or termination (for any reason), Vendor shall provide reasonable transition assistance, including data export, knowledge transfer, and reasonable cooperation with a successor provider, at the rates in the applicable Order Form (or, where termination is for Vendor's breach, at no charge). Vendor shall not delete, degrade, or withhold access to Customer Data during the transition period, and shall not condition transition assistance on payment of disputed amounts or on a release.
replacement.comment: Replace with full transition assistance and data-return protection.

findings.quote: During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
findings.rationale: Unbounded 24-month non-compete restraining Customer's business and M&A; contradicts §12.3.

replacement.oldText: During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
replacement.comment: Delete in full; confidentiality obligations in §16.2 already protect Vendor.

findings.quote: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
findings.rationale: At-will revocable licence excluding Affiliates/contractors; contradicts §§13.2, 13.3, 24.1 and Affiliate ordering.

replacement.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
replacement.newText: 13.1 Subject to this Agreement, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a worldwide, non-exclusive, irrevocable (during the applicable subscription term) licence to access and use the Services and Documentation for their internal business purposes, including through contractors, service providers, and Authorized Users acting on their behalf, for whose compliance Customer is responsible. Vendor may suspend or revoke access only as expressly permitted by Section 13.3.
replacement.comment: Broaden licence scope and remove discretionary revocation.

findings.quote: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
findings.rationale: 15-day warranty with total remedy cut-off operates as a disguised disclaimer cutting off §19.1 and §19.4 remedies.

replacement.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
replacement.newText: 19.2 Each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and the applicable acceptance criteria for ninety (90) days after acceptance. The warranty period in this Section does not limit Section 19.1, Section 19.4, or any other remedy available to Customer, and does not operate as a limitation period for any claim.
replacement.comment: Extend to 90 days and remove remedy cut-off.

findings.quote: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
findings.rationale: One-month fee cap 'without exception' overrides Excluded Claims; cap base further shrunk by §1.5 Fees definition. Excluded Claims also omit §19.3 and §26 breaches.

replacement.oldText: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
replacement.newText: 21.1 Subject to Sections 21.3 and 21.4, each Party's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the greater of (a) USD [—] and (b) the total amounts paid and payable by Customer under the applicable Order Form in the twelve (12) months preceding the first event giving rise to the claim. Liability for Excluded Claims is not subject to this cap.
replacement.comment: 12-month cap with Excluded Claims preserved; amend §1.5 so 'Fees' includes implementation and one-time charges.

findings.quote: 20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
findings.rationale: No Vendor indemnity at all (no IP, data-breach or compliance indemnity); Customer indemnity is unlimited and uncapped; §9.3 cross-refers to non-existent §20.5.

replacement.oldText: 20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
replacement.newText:
20. INDEMNIFICATION
20.1 Vendor IP Indemnity. Vendor shall defend Customer, its Affiliates, and their personnel against any third-party claim that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, or trade secret, and shall indemnify against resulting damages, settlements, and reasonable costs.
20.2 Vendor Other Indemnities. Vendor shall defend and indemnify Customer against third-party claims arising from (a) Vendor's breach of Sections 15, 16 or 17 or a Security Incident affecting Customer Data; (b) Vendor's violation of Applicable Law; (c) death, personal injury, or tangible property damage caused by Vendor; and (d) claims by Vendor personnel or subcontractors relating to their engagement.
20.3 Customer Indemnity. Customer shall defend and indemnify Vendor against third-party claims that Customer Data, as provided by Customer, infringes third-party IP or violates Applicable Law, except to the extent arising from Vendor's breach, negligence, or wilful misconduct.
20.4 Procedure. Prompt notice (delay excuses only to the extent of prejudice), indemnitor control of defence with reputable counsel, indemnitee right to participate at its own cost, no settlement imposing liability, admission, or non-monetary obligation on the indemnitee without consent.
20.5 Infringement Remedies. If a claim under 20.1 arises or is reasonably likely, Vendor shall at its expense (a) procure the right to continue use; or (b) modify or replace the item so it is non-infringing with materially equivalent functionality. If neither is achievable within thirty (30) days, either Party may terminate the affected Order Form and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees plus, for perpetual/paid-up items, Fees paid depreciated on a five-year straight-line basis. Exclusions: no obligation to the extent infringement arises solely from Customer Data or Customer's unauthorised modification.
replacement.comment: Reciprocal indemnity structure; also repairs the §9.3 cross-reference.

findings.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period
findings.rationale: Vendor has full audit rights over Customer while §23 (Customer assurance) is an empty heading; audit right also lacks a self-help remedy limit.

findings.quote: the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer
findings.rationale: 'Improve the Services' is broader than §15.1 limits and could permit product development on Customer material; §1.3 telemetry carve-out lacks de-identification standard and re-identification ban.

replacement.oldText: solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer
replacement.newText: solely to provide, secure, and support the Services for Customer, and to improve the Services provided that such improvement does not involve use of Customer Data other than as permitted by Section 15.1

findings.quote: professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000
findings.rationale: E&O limit low for deal size; cancellation notice only 'to the extent available'; no additional insured, waiver of subrogation, or tail coverage.

findings.quote: governed by the laws of the State of New York
findings.rationale: New York law and exclusive New York County venue accepted; only minor confirmation on escalation carve-out noted.

findings.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty days' prior written notice
findings.rationale: Customer-favourable convenience termination with refund; concern is only that §2.1 undermines it.

findings.quote: renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal
findings.rationale: Short 30-day opt-out with reminder obligation; no issue raised in the review.

findings.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor
findings.rationale: Assignment and change-of-control provisions are customer-favourable; no issue flagged.
